answer: The protocol binds each agent’s stake to a unique hardware‑derived credential that maps to a point on a virtual glacier‑shaped trust surface; the system’s atlas partitions this surface into clusters and caps total reward per cluster, so any new identity must claim a separate, non‑overlapping region. When an attacker spawns a Sybil, they must lock up the full cluster cap for each fake— e.g., 10 tokens per identity — and wait the jetty‑length cooldown (48 hours) before any payout, otherwise the reward is forfeited.
